$Comment: A spot a bar panel can sit at: the top-left, at the same origin as the zone card another mod
draws there, deliberately OVER it: the panel is transparent behind its frame, it attaches after
the card so it draws on top, and the two read fine stacked, whereas sitting below the card and
the mob inspector would push the ledger halfway down the screen. Measured for the tall activity
ledger (the Default panel) and offered to the wide World panel too: one narrow column until the
column is full (thirteen rows), then a second one beside it rather than running off the bottom
Position is a corner preset (TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, CenterLeft, Center, CenterRight,
BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight) plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins.
Columns and RowsPerColumn say how the rows spread out here; a panel never opens more columns
than its own document declares, nor fills a column deeper than its document allows. Panels
lists which panels offer this spot; leave it out to offer it to every panel. LabelKey names the
spot in the HUD settings, in each player's own language.
To retune a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'TopLeft' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-placements.json with only the leaves you want different. To add a
spot of your own, drop another file in this folder: every picker offers it at once.
